title: The Celestial Paradox
subtitle: Celestial Signs in Biblical and Apocryphal Texts
author: Acuity Institute
description: Examines the tension in ancient texts between reverence for a divinely ordered heaven and condemnation of divination, drawing on the Qumran 364-day calendar, Enochic astronomy and Mesopotamian omen literature such as Enuma Anu Enlil. A modern research presentation from the Acuity Institute collection.
